# three.js r128

Vendored from the official `three@0.128.0` npm package:
https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.128.0.tgz

- `three.min.js`: `package/build/three.min.js`
- `OrbitControls.js`: `package/examples/js/controls/OrbitControls.js`
- `LICENSE`: the package's MIT license

Both scripts must stay on the same version. They are loaded locally so rendering
does not require access to a public CDN. Include this directory when copying or
deploying `index.html`; opening the complete project via `file://` is also supported.
